summary: Analog Atlas is a 3D atlas in the browser that finds the places on Earth that best match Moon base sites and Mars landing zones, using real, sourced NASA and open data. It compares 19 Earth analog sites on 6 continents with 13 Moon and Mars targets on four pillars: climate, ground slope, rock type and the resources a base needs. Every value has a source; if a value was not measured, the app says "not measured" and never invents a number. Harrat al-Shaam in Jordan is the world's best match for the Moon's Mare Tranquillitatis lava-tube pit (71%) and scores 84% for the Arsia Mons cave skylight on Mars, one point behind Craters of the Moon, USA. We also screened all of Jordan in 886 boxes of 10 km to find new candidates. Users can fly down in 3D, compare real photos in Twin view, tune the weights, run a stability check and open a concept base at each starred pair. This helps mission teams choose where on Earth to test first, and shows that strong training grounds exist in Jordan.
details: Analog Atlas is a 3D globe of Earth, the Moon and Mars (CesiumJS) that ranks 19 Earth analog sites against 13 Moon and Mars targets on four pillars: climate, ground slope, rock type and resources. Every value has a published source; if a value was not measured, the app says "not measured". Harrat al-Shaam, Jordan, is the world's best match for the Moon's Mare Tranquillitatis lava-tube pit (71%) and scores 84% for the Arsia Mons cave skylight on Mars, one point behind Craters of the Moon, USA. Discover Jordan scores all of Jordan in 886 boxes of 10 km. Features: 3D fly-down, Twin view photos, tunable weights, a stability check and a concept base at each starred pair. Next step (concept): a low-cost rocker-bogie rover to check the ground and calibrate satellite data. Data: NASA POWER, MODIS, EMIT, ASTER, GIBS, LRO LOLA/Diviner/LROC, MGS MOLA/TES, Mars Climate Sounder, Copernicus DEM, Sentinel-2. Tools: JavaScript, CesiumJS, Python, GitHub Pages; 74 automated tests. SI use: Claude (Anthropic) helped write code and text and made slide drawings, marked "SI-assisted".
